# 2. ✨ `feature_request.md`

```markdown
---
name: ✨ Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement for DeceptionX
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: "help-wanted"
assignees: ""
---

## Problem

What problem would this feature solve?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the feature or behavior you would like to see.

## DeceptionX Component

Which part of the project would this affect?

- [ ] Honeypots
- [ ] Suricata / IDS
- [ ] Perception
- [ ] Agent / Decision Logic
- [ ] potctl
- [ ] Storage / Audit
- [ ] Frontend / Dashboard
- [ ] Infrastructure
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other

## Why Would This Be Useful?

Explain how this feature would improve DeceptionX.

## Possible Implementation

If you have an implementation idea, describe it here.

## Security Considerations

Could this change affect:

- Network exposure
- Docker privileges
- Authentication / authorization
- Automated actions
- Filesystem access
- Sensitive data

Explain any potential risks and how they could be controlled.

## Additional Context

Add examples, diagrams, screenshots, research papers, or other references if relevant.
